body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled its ‘second-generation Blu-ray player (mddel: BD-P1200)’ for the home entertainment industry.

Samsung expects that the ‘BD-P1200’ player will help the company stay a step ahead of the cutting-edge optical media industry, after introducing the first Blu-ray DiscTM (BD) player (model: BD-P1000) to the U.S. market in June 2006.
